hpe_engine_create.brief: 创建引擎实例并初始化像素缓冲 / Create an engine instance and initialise its pixel buffer

params.width: 窗口宽度（像素），非正时回退为 800 / Window width in pixels, falls back to 800 when non-positive
params.height: 窗口高度（像素），非正时回退为 600 / Window height in pixels, falls back to 600 when non-positive

hpe_engine_create.return: 新引擎实例；调用方最终须用 `hpe_engine_destroy` 释放 / The new engine instance; the caller must eventually release it with `hpe_engine_destroy`

hpe_engine_destroy.brief: 销毁引擎并释放全部资源 / Destroy the engine and release all resources

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL

hpe_engine_destroy.note: 释放盒树、DOM、样式表、像素缓冲与 JS 上下文，并关闭进程级字体子系统 / Frees the box tree, DOM, stylesheet, pixel buffer and JS context, and shuts the process-wide font subsystem down

hpe_engine_load_file.brief: 加载并排版一个 HTML 文件 / Load and lay out an HTML file

params.path: 要加载的文件路径 / Path of the file to load

hpe_engine_load_file.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when loaded, otherwise 0

retval.1: 已读取、解析并排版；启用地址栏时地址栏写入绝对路径 / Read, parsed and laid out; the absolute path is written into the address bar when chrome is enabled
retval.0: `engine`/`path` 为 NULL，或文件无法打开（错误写入状态行）/ `engine` or `path` is NULL, or the file could not be opened (the error is stored in the status line)

hpe_engine_load_file.note: 相对资源（样式表、脚本、`<base href>`）以该文件所在目录为基准 / Relative resources (stylesheets, scripts, `<base href>`) resolve against the file's directory

hpe_engine_load_blank.brief: 加载内置空白页 / Load the built-in blank page

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_engine_load_blank.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when loaded, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_load_blank.note: 无文件参数启动时使用；相对资源以 `.` 为基准；启用地址栏时清空地址并失焦 / Used when the engine starts without a file argument; relative resources resolve against `.`; clears and blurs the address bar when chrome is enabled

hpe_engine_reload.brief: 重新加载当前文档 / Reload the current document

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL

hpe_engine_reload.return: 加载成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when reloaded, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_reload.note: 尚无文档路径时改为加载内置空白页 / Loads the built-in blank page when no path is set

hpe_engine_resize.brief: 调整窗口与像素缓冲尺寸并重排 / Resize the window and pixel buffer and relayout

params.width: 新的窗口宽度（像素）/ New window width in pixels
params.height: 新的窗口高度（像素）/ New window height in pixels

hpe_engine_resize.note: 宽高非正或与当前完全一致时不做任何事；否则重设缓冲、重排并刷新状态行 / Does nothing for non-positive or unchanged dimensions; otherwise resizes the buffer, relayouts and refreshes the status line

hpe_engine_scroll_by.brief: 按行滚动页面 / Scroll the page by a number of lines

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL
params.lines: 滚动的行数，正为下滚、负为上滚 / Number of lines to scroll, positive scrolls down and negative up

hpe_engine_scroll_by.note: 一行等于 `HPE_SCROLL_LINE_PX` 像素；滚动偏移夹到 `[0, content_height - view_height]` 后取整到整像素，使损伤矩形路径与全量重绘逐字节一致；仅在未脏时把脏标记置为 `HPE_DIRTY_SCROLL` / One line is `HPE_SCROLL_LINE_PX` pixels; the offset is clamped to `[0, content_height - view_height]` then snapped to whole pixels so the damage-rect path stays byte-identical to a full repaint; only sets the dirty flag to `HPE_DIRTY_SCROLL` when not already dirty

hpe_engine_mouse_event.brief: 派发一次鼠标按下 / 抬起 / Deliver a mouse press/release

params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space
params.button: 鼠标按键（0 = 左键）/ Mouse button (0 = left)
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released

hpe_engine_mouse_event.return: 页面发生变更返回 1（引擎已重排，窗口应重绘），否则 0 / 1 when the page mutated (the engine already relaid-out and the window should repaint), otherwise 0
hpe_engine_mouse_event.note: 点击落在地址栏条带内或页面点击使地址栏失焦时同样返回 1；等价于修饰键掩码为 0 的 `hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods` / Also returns 1 for a click inside the chrome strip or when a page click blurs the address bar; equivalent to `hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods` with a zero modifier mask

hpe_engine_mouse_move.brief: 处理指针移动：更新 `:hover` 状态并触发 `mousemove` 监听器 / Handle a pointer move: update `:hover` state and fire `mousemove` listeners

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或无盒树时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL or without a box tree
params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space

hpe_engine_mouse_move.return: 需要重绘返回 1（悬停变化或有监听器改动了页面），否则 0 / 1 when a repaint is needed (hover changed or a listener mutated the page), otherwise 0
hpe_engine_mouse_move.note: 悬停变化总是强制重排（`:hover` 是选择器，须重新级联）；否则仅在监听器产生变更时惰性重排；地址栏拖选进行中时优先交给地址栏 / A hover change always forces a relayout (`:hover` is a selector and needs a fresh cascade); otherwise a listener-driven change is relaid out lazily; a live address-bar drag is handed off to the bar first

hpe_engine_tick.brief: 泵到期定时器与 requestAnimationFrame 队列 / Drain due timers and the requestAnimationFrame queue

params.engine: 引擎实例，无 JS 上下文时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 without a JS context

hpe_engine_tick.return: 有回调运行返回 1（页面应重排并重绘），否则 0 / 1 when at least one callback ran (the page should be relaid out and repainted), otherwise 0
hpe_engine_tick.note: 每轮只处理已到期的回调，期间新增的留待下一轮 / Only callbacks already due are run; ones added during the pass wait for the next round

hpe_engine_render.brief: 按脏标记把引擎绘制到像素缓冲 / Paint the engine into its pixel buffer according to the dirty flag

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL

hpe_engine_render.note: 无变更且已绘制过时整帧跳过，使无实际效果的 DOM 变更免费；仅脏地址栏时只重画地址栏，仅滚动时走局部位移重绘，否则整帧重绘；用后取 `hpe_engine_pixmap` 获取结果 / Skips the whole frame when nothing changed and a frame exists, making a no-op DOM mutation free; repaints only the bar when just the chrome is dirty, does a shift-based partial repaint for scroll-only damage, otherwise repaints the whole frame; fetch the result with `hpe_engine_pixmap`

hpe_engine_enable_chrome.brief: 为引擎启用自绘地址栏 / Enable the engine's self-drawn address bar

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或已启用时直接返回 / Engine instance, returns early when NULL or already enabled

hpe_engine_enable_chrome.note: 启用后视口变窄，页面在地址栏下方排版并接收相对自身的鼠标坐标；已排版则重排以重新夹紧滚动，否则标记整帧重绘 / Enabling narrows the viewport: the page lays out below the bar and receives mouse coordinates relative to itself; a laid-out document is relaid to re-clamp the scroll, otherwise the whole frame is marked dirty

hpe_engine_chrome_height.brief: 取地址栏高度 / Get the address-bar height
hpe_engine_chrome_height.return: 地址栏高度（像素），未启用时为 0 / Address-bar height in pixels, 0 when disabled
hpe_engine_chrome_height.note: 窗口坐标减去该值即得页面视口坐标 / Subtracting this from a window coordinate gives the page viewport coordinate

hpe_engine_address_text.brief: 取地址栏当前文本 / Get the address bar's current text
hpe_engine_address_text.return: 地址文本（UTF-8），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The address text in UTF-8, an empty string when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_address_focused.brief: 查询地址栏是否获得焦点 / Query whether the address bar is focused
hpe_engine_address_focused.return: 聚焦返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when focused, otherwise 0

hpe_engine_address_selection.brief: 取地址栏选区的字节范围 / Get the byte range of the selected address text

params.start: out:接收选区起始字节偏移，可为 NULL / Receives the selection start byte offset, may be NULL
params.end: out:接收选区结束字节偏移，可为 NULL / Receives the selection end byte offset, may be NULL

hpe_engine_address_selection.return: 选取非空返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the selection is non-empty, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_address_selection.note: 空选区（只有插入符）返回 0 且不写出任何输出，与 omnibox 一致 / An empty selection (only a caret) returns 0 and writes nothing, exactly like the omnibox

hpe_engine_address_caret.brief: 取插入符在地址文本中的字节偏移 / Get the byte offset of the insertion point (the caret) in the address text
hpe_engine_address_caret.return: 插入符字节偏移，`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Caret byte offset, 0 when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods.brief: 带修饰键地派发一次鼠标按下 / 抬起 / Deliver a mouse press/release with modifiers

params.engine: 引擎实例，NULL 或无盒树时返回 0 / Engine instance, returns 0 when NULL or without a box tree
params.x: X 坐标（窗口坐标）/ X coordinate in window space
params.y: Y 坐标（窗口坐标）/ Y coordinate in window space
params.button: 鼠标按键（0 = 左键；当前实现未使用）/ Mouse button (0 = left; currently unused by the implementation)
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released
params.mods: `HPE_MOD_*` 修饰键掩码 / The `HPE_MOD_*` modifier mask

hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods.return: 触发监听器或使地址栏失焦返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when a listener fired or the address bar was blurred, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_mouse_event_mods.note: 与 `hpe_engine_mouse_event` 相同，但额外携带修饰键掩码：Shift+点击扩展地址栏选区 / Same as `hpe_engine_mouse_event` but carries a modifier mask: Shift+click extends the address-bar selection

hpe_engine_key.brief: 无修饰键地向地址栏送入一个按键 / Feed one key stroke to the chrome with no modifier

params.key: 可打印码点（Unicode）或 `HPE_KEY_*` 键码 / A printable code point (Unicode) or an `HPE_KEY_*` key code

hpe_engine_key.return: 地址栏消费了该输入返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the chrome consumed the input, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_key.details: 接受的键包括可打印码点，以及 `HPE_KEY_BACKSPACE`、`HPE_KEY_DELETE`、`HPE_KEY_LEFT`/`RIGHT`/`HOME`/`END`、`HPE_KEY_RETURN`（导航到所输入的路径）、`HPE_KEY_ESCAPE`（回退到该字段获得焦点时的地址，然后失焦），以及 `HPE_KEY_PASTE`/`COPY`/`CUT`/`SELECT_ALL` 快捷键。| Accepted keys are printable code points plus `HPE_KEY_BACKSPACE`, `HPE_KEY_DELETE`, `HPE_KEY_LEFT`/`RIGHT`/`HOME`/`END`, `HPE_KEY_RETURN` (navigates to the typed path), `HPE_KEY_ESCAPE` (restores the address the field got focus with, then blurs) and the `HPE_KEY_PASTE`/`COPY`/`CUT`/`SELECT_ALL` shortcuts.
hpe_engine_key.note: 所有键都先作用于选区，与普通文本框一致：输入或退格替换选区，方向键折叠选区，Ctrl+C/X 对选区操作；等价于修饰键掩码为 0 的 `hpe_engine_key_mods` / All of them act on the selection first, like any text field: typing or backspace replaces it, arrows collapse it, and Ctrl+C/X operate on it; equivalent to `hpe_engine_key_mods` with a zero modifier mask

hpe_engine_key_mods.brief: 带修饰键地把按键送给地址栏 / Send a key stroke with modifiers to the address bar

params.key: 可打印码点（Unicode）或 `HPE_KEY_*` 键码 / A printable code point (Unicode) or an `HPE_KEY_*` key code
params.mods: `HPE_MOD_*` 修饰键掩码 / The `HPE_MOD_*` modifier mask

hpe_engine_key_mods.return: 地址栏消费了该输入返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the chrome consumed the input, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_key_mods.note: 与 `hpe_engine_key` 相同，但额外携带修饰键掩码：Shift 扩展选区、Ctrl 按单词移动 / Same as `hpe_engine_key` but carries a modifier mask: Shift extends the selection and Ctrl moves by word

hpe_engine_pixmap.brief: 取引擎的像素缓冲（上一帧结果）/ Get the engine's pixel buffer (the last frame)
hpe_engine_pixmap.return: 像素缓冲指针，`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 `NULL` / Pointer to the pixel buffer, `NULL` when `engine` is NULL
hpe_engine_pixmap.note: 须在 `hpe_engine_render` 之后读取，直到下次 `hpe_engine_resize` 前有效 / Read it after `hpe_engine_render`; valid until the next `hpe_engine_resize`

hpe_engine_status.brief: 取状态行文本 / Get the status-line text
hpe_engine_status.return: 状态文本（含文件名、尺寸、加载/绘制耗时、滚动位置，及粘性加载错误），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The status text (file name, size, load/paint timings, scroll position and any sticky load error), an empty string when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_scroll_offset.brief: 取当前纵向滚动偏移 / Get the current vertical scroll offset
hpe_engine_scroll_offset.return: 滚动偏移（像素，整像素取整后），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Scroll offset in pixels (snapped to whole pixels), 0 when `engine` is NULL

hpe_engine_document_encoding.brief: 取上次加载文档所用的字符编码 / Get the charset the last loaded document was decoded from
hpe_engine_document_encoding.return: 编码名（`utf-8`、`latin1`、`utf-16le`、`utf-16be`），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回空串 / The charset label (`utf-8`, `latin1`, `utf-16le`, `utf-16be`), an empty string when `engine` is NULL
hpe_engine_document_encoding.note: 直到下次加载前有效 / Valid until the next load

hpe_engine_meta_charset.brief: 查询编码是否来自文档内 `<meta charset>` / Query whether the charset came from an in-document `<meta charset>`
hpe_engine_meta_charset.return: 来自文档内 `<meta charset>` 返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it came from an in-document `<meta charset>`, otherwise 0
hpe_engine_meta_charset.note: 与来自 BOM 或 UTF-8 校验的情况相区分 / Distinguishes it from a BOM or UTF-8 validation

hpe_engine_base_href.brief: 取解析后的 `<base href>` / Get the resolved `<base href>`
hpe_engine_base_href.return: 绝对基址，文档未声明时返回空串 / The absolute base URL, an empty string when the document declares none

hpe_engine_link_count.brief: 取非 stylesheet 的 `<link>` 资源数 / Get the number of non-stylesheet `<link>` resources
hpe_engine_link_count.return: 记录的 `<link>` 资源提示个数（icon/preload/alternate 等），`engine` 为 NULL 时返回 0 / Number of recorded `<link>` resource hints (icon/preload/alternate ...), 0 when `engine` is NULL
hpe_engine_link_count.note: stylesheet 链接已被消费、不计入 / Stylesheet links are consumed and are not counted

hpe_engine_link_at.brief: 取某条 `<link>` 资源提示的归一化 rel 与解析后的绝对 href / Get a `<link>` resource hint's normalised rel token and resolved absolute href

params.index: 资源提示下标（0 起）/ Resource hint index (zero based)
params.rel: out:接收归一化（小写、空格分隔）的 rel token 串，可为 NULL / Receives the normalised (lowercase, space-separated) rel token string, may be NULL
params.href: out:接收解析后的绝对地址，可为 NULL / Receives the resolved absolute URL, may be NULL

hpe_engine_link_at.return: `index` 有效返回 1，越界返回 0 / 1 for a valid `index`, 0 when out of range
hpe_engine_link_at.note: `index` 越界时不写出任何输出 / Nothing is written when `index` is out of range
